I wanted the streetlamp to be the focal point, so I kept the nighttime areas cool with blues and purples and switched to brighter, warmer colors wherever the light hits. I also added a soft rainbow reflection across the wet fence and used white highlights at the end to make everything feel shiny after the rain. 🌈✨ One thing I’m trying to share more in these videos is why I choose certain colors and where I place them, instead of only showing the finished page. Bear tutorial 0-2.33 Bush tutorial 2.33 - 4.31 *Watch till the end for the palette listed a few people have ask me how exactly do I “paint” on or color match my acrylics. I like to use alcohol markers over acrylics to soften and change the color of acrylics. Just be aware that this can ruin your marker nib. I like to change out my nibs after awhile of use.  This is the first part, showing how I colored the bear and bush from my beekeeper page. The second part will focus on the sky portion and picnic table.  Sorry for the out of focus shots.
